notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) succeeded fully - no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. robots.txt checked first (Allow: / for User-agent: *, ClaudeBot, Googlebot etc, only /admin /cart /profile /checkout /s?q=* disallowed - none of those blocked this work). TREE: containerstore.com is a Next.js app; every page embeds a <script id=__NEXT_DATA__> JSON blob containing initialState.categories (full L1/L2/L3 nav tree with hrefs) AND initialState.plp.data.totalCount (exact product count for that listing page) AND initialState.plp.filters['category'] (a facet listing every sibling/child category with its own exact count) in one fetch. Built the full tree from the home-decor page's categories.L1Categories/L2Categories/L3Categories, then fetched one page per relevant L1 branch (/s/storage/1, /s/closet/1, /s/kitchen/1, /s/bath/1, /s/office/1, /s/garage-and-shelving/1, /s/elfa/1, plus the BEYOND brand section) and read each page's own category facet for all its children's exact counts in a single request - per the task's efficiency note for this large storage retailer, recorded rows at the L2 level (using each L2's facet-provided exact count) rather than fetching every L3 leaf individually; L2 pages are themselves genuine standalone category/subcategory listing pages. QTY: every qty is plp.data.totalCount / plp.filters category-facet 'count' read directly from the __NEXT_DATA__ JSON of the relevant listing page - never estimated or aggregated. EXCLUDED (not Textile/Storage, or promotional/duplicate, so left out entirely): Custom Spaces L1 (design-tool/collection landing pages), College L1 (persona cross-sell collection, links duplicate other sections), Featured L1 and Clearance L1 (brand/trend/clearance collections), Travel L1 (luggage/travel-gear vertical, out of home-storage scope), Cleaning L1 (cleaning products/tools, its only unique-content nodes were duplicate hrefs of Closet's Hampers & Carts), Kitchen's 'Prep Gadgets & Accessories'/'Tabletop and Barware'/'Kitchen Cleaning' and all 'Getting Started'/'How To Get Started' guide pages (duplicate content of the real subcategory pages) and 'The Everything Organizer' (brand collection), Office's 'Desktop Collections'/'Craft & Hobby'/'Office Supplies'/'Tech Accessories'/'Notebooks Planners & Calendars'/'Cord Control'/'Labels & Label Makers'/'Message Boards & Accessories'/'Desk Chairs' (general supplies/furniture, not storage), Storage's 'Like it' (brand collection) and 'Clearance: Storage', Closet's 'Clothing & Shoe Care' (care products) and 'Custom Closet Spaces'/'Closet Systems'/'Everything Organizer' (design tool/brand collection), Garage's 'Stepstools and Ladders' (tools/furniture), Elfa's 'Complete Your Elfa Space' (room-by-room cross-sell collection duplicating Components/PreDesigned content), 'Best Selling Solutions' (curated bestseller cross-cut) and 'Closeouts' (clearance), Decor's 'Decorative Shelving & Furniture'/'Home Fragrances'/'Air Quality'/'Decorative Objects & Vases'/'Frames & Photobooks'/'Mirrors' (Furniture/Decorative-Accessories/Wall-Decor per those already-validated files, out of scope here), BEYOND's 'Kitchen Bed Bath Beyond' (keyword scan showed Cookware/Knife/Blender dominant over Towel, i.e. primarily Kitchen & Dining not Textile). Confirmed via site-search spot checks (towel=241, curtain=69, rug=79, duvet=50, blanket=96, tablecloth=100, napkin=29, bathrobe=33 results) that real textile inventory exists on the site but is concentrated almost entirely inside Decor's 'Bedding Essentials'/'Pillows & Throws' and BEYOND's 'Bedding'/'Bath' pages recorded above - no separate standalone Towels/Curtains/Rugs category exists anywhere in the site's own L1-L3 navigation tree. Two rows carry a genuine mixed-content flag rather than a split (no distinct sub-URL exists to separate the two product types): Bath > Shower & Bathtub (storage caddies dominant, but contains shower curtains/bath mats) and Closet > Laundry Room Accessories (storage items mixed with non-storage laundry consumables).
